basicInfo.name: Nuri
basicInfo.flavor: Upon draping a tiger hide over himself and chanting a forbidden incantation, the pelt began wrapping around Nuri's body as though it had come alive.\nThe animals of the forest began mistaking him for a real tiger and cleared a wide path for him when he approached.

profile.story: The tigers of Shinji were so massive and ferocious that not even the most renowned tiger-slayers dared to pursue them recklessly. When a group of tiger-slayers caught one by chance, Nuri purchased its hide for a handsome sum and draped it over himself. Then, upon chanting a spell, all animals that came near him began mistaking him for a tiger, fleeing whenever he came near.\n\nInitially, he used this power only to hunt wild animals or venture deep into remote forests to gather medicinal herbs. However, as his greed gradually grew, he began using his powers to terrorize unsuspecting travelers and plunder their wealth.

basicInfo.name: Nuri
basicInfo.flavor: He was eventually caught stealing and selling other hunters' game.\nAs people began pelting him with stones and treating him with open contempt, Nuri —believing his shabby appearance was the cause— acquired a colorful garment to wear instead.
